items.title: Fred Staton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 12, 2008
items.q: And we were angry. I was angry, as most of us were. And it was a question of, why him?

ctx.x: Yeah. It’s a spiritual thing. Anyone can pick it up as you go along. Either you do or you don’t.
You were, let’s see, in 1965 or so you were around 50. I think it was a couple of days ago that it was 40 years ago since Martin Luther King was assassinated.
